versions.content: If the return value of Dem_J1939DcmReadDiagnosticReadiness3 is unequal E_OK, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_NEGATIVE to send a negative acknowledgement (NACK) (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).
